title: Money Mule
tagline: A tool for investors and founders to save time and trigger funding based on milestones

prizes.title: Best dApp built on Saga Chain

description:
Our platform fixes this: founders unlock funds in milestone-based installments tied to their proven track record and on-demand expert support, while investors confidently back vetted projects, releasing capital step by step to reduce risk

This benefits both founders and investors
how_its_made:
MoneyMule.xyz is built as a sophisticated multi-agent system using CrewAI to orchestrate specialized AI agents for comprehensive startup analysis. The backend leverages FastAPI for high-performance API endpoints and OpenAI GPT-4o-mini for intelligent analysis across multiple domains.

Core Architecture:
6 Specialized Agents: Viability assessment, founder research, competitive analysis, compliance evaluation, follow-up question generation, and executive summarization
Multi-Source Data Integration: Combines Google Search scraping, and GitRoll API for comprehensive founder profiling
Advanced File Processing: Extracts text from PDF, PPTX.
Parallel Processing: Agents run concurrently for 30-60 second analysis times

Technical Stack:
Frontend:
Next.js, Typescript, Bun, Tailwind CSS, ShadcnUI, framer motion.

Backend:
Python, FastAPI, CrewAI

Smart Contracts:
Solidity, Hardhat, Flow Blockchain.

Other: 
Docker, Git/GitHub, Mermaid, Figma, OpenAI.
